verdict.rationale: Datadog has a dedicated first-party "OpenTelemetry in Datadog" documentation section, which shows OpenTelemetry is a supported, documented path into the platform. The pack contains only the page title, though, so nothing confirms that telemetry can be sent directly over OTLP without the Datadog Agent or Collector, or that support is first-class. Missing for 10: evidence of direct OTLP intake endpoints (traces, metrics, logs), detail on whether the Datadog Agent or Collector is required, first-class parity with native instrumentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
